# Claude Code Skills: Substitutions, Injection, and Invocation

A skill body can hold placeholders that Claude Code fills in when the skill runs.
The string substitutions, the shell injection syntax, and the keys that control who can call a skill are listed below.
For example, `$ARGUMENTS` in a `SKILL.md` file becomes the text that you type after the command.
The marks are explained on [Skills and Commands](Claude-Code-Skills-And-Commands).

## String Substitutions

| Mark | Item | What It Does | How It Works | Where It Can Be Used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `$ARGUMENTS` | All arguments as typed. | With no placeholder, Claude Code appends `ARGUMENTS: <value>`. | All skills. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `$ARGUMENTS[N]`, `$N` | One argument by 0-based index. | Shell-style quotes group words. A missing index stays as text. | All skills. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `$name` | Named argument from `arguments`. | A missing value gives an empty string. | All skills. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `\$1` | Escape. | One backslash before a token gives the literal text. `\\$1` still expands. | All skills. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID}` | Session ID. | Not replaced in synced skills. | All skills. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `${CLAUDE_EFFORT}` | Current effort level. | `low` to `max`. | All skills. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}` | Directory of the `SKILL.md`. | Also replaced in `allowed-tools` Bash rules. In a plugin it is the skill subdirectory. | All skills. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}` | Project root. | Replaced in content and `allowed-tools`. | All skills. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`, `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}` | Plugin paths. | Only in plugin skills. | Plugin skills. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Plugin Loading Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/loading) |
| ✅ | `${user_config.KEY}` | Saved plugin option. | In skill and agent content only non-sensitive values. See [Plugins Manifest](Claude-Code-Plugins-Manifest). | Plugin skills. | - |
| 🔍 | Total size cap | Stops huge fills. | Error "This skill, command or hook and the arguments filled into it add up to more than N characters". Argument values are marked so `$` in them is not expanded. | All skills. | bundle message "This skill, command or hook and the arguments filled into it add up to more than" |

## Shell Injection

| Mark | Item | What It Does | How It Works | Where It Can Be Used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `` !`command` `` | Runs a command and inserts its output. | Only at a line start or after whitespace. Output is not scanned again. | User, project, plugin skills. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | Fenced block with a `!` after the opening backticks | Multi-line command. | Same rules. | Same. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | Failure | Aborts the whole invocation. | `Shell command failed for pattern "..."`. Exit code 1 of search commands is a normal result. Permission failure: `Shell command permission check failed`. | Same. | [Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `disableSkillShellExecution` | Replaces each command with `[shell command execution disabled by policy]`. | Bundled and managed skills are not affected. | Settings. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Settings Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference) |
| ✅ | Synced skills | Never run `!` commands. | Also `@` files and two placeholders are not expanded. | Synced. | [Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |

## Invocation Control

| Mark | Item | What It Does | How It Works | Where It Can Be Used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | Default | You and Claude can invoke. | The description is always in context. | All. | [Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `disable-model-invocation: true` | Only you invoke. | The description is not in context. | All. | [Commands](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/commands), [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `user-invocable: false` | Only Claude invokes. | Hidden from the `/` menu. | All. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | Name at the start of a message | Runs the skill. | After plain text it only grants permission. Up to five more skills can be stacked in a terminal prompt. | Interactive. | [Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `Skill(name)` and `Skill(name *)` rules | Permission rules for the `Skill` tool. | A deny on an alias blocks the bundled skill. Allow rules match the skill name only. | Permissions. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | Lifecycle | Content stays in the conversation. | An identical re-invoke adds a short note. Compaction keeps 5,000 tokens for each skill and 25,000 in total. | All. | [Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| ✅ | `context: fork` | Runs in a subagent. | Background by default. It waits in `-p`, with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS=1`, and for scheduled tasks. | All. | [Extend Claude with Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |
| 🔍 | Commit-time skills | `verify`, `pr`, `commit`, `code-review`, `simplify`, `go` | A set of these names is used when the commit text is built. Docs name `verify` and `simplify` (v2.1.286). | All. | bundle `new Set(["verify","pr","commit","code-review","simplify","go"])` |
